summary: Today’s market mood is broadly constructive for crypto and risk assets, with analysts leaning bullish on BTC and ETH while warning that rates and macro conditions still matter. Reuters also shows gold and Brent holding firm, and equities remain supported by AI-led strength, suggesting a mixed but risk-on backdrop.
